title: sync script: no guard that merges run on main; REPO_ROOT HEAD-dependent
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 1.3. :251 gates on main but 'git merge' merges into whatever HEAD the REPO_ROOT checkout has; if launched from a worker worktree the script ships inside, every merge lands on the worker's branch. Fix: assert 'git symbolic-ref HEAD == refs/heads/main' after :58, else abort.
